LevelSettings.Title: Level Settings
LevelSettings.CompiledLevelFileLabel: Target folder and filename for level file:
LevelSettings.GameFolderLabel: Folder in which all runtime game components reside:
LevelSettings.ScriptPathLabel: Path of TXT files for script (Optional)
LevelSettings.LuaPathLabel: Path of Lua level script file:
LevelSettings.GameExecutableLabel: Target executable that is started with the `Build and Play` button
LevelSettings.TrxConvertFlybysToCinematicFrames: Convert flyby cameras into cinematic frames
LevelSettings.DefaultLightQualityTooltip: Raytracing quality for all lights with `Default` light quality setting
LevelSettings.TexturePaddingTooltip:
Edge pixel padding to prevent texture border bleeding.
If set to 0, seams between textures may become visible.
LevelSettings.AggressiveTexturePacking: Aggressive texture packing (merge object and room textures)
LevelSettings.AggressiveTexturePackingTooltip:
Pack both object and room textures in the same texture pages.
Recommended mode for TR1-TR3 targets.
LevelSettings.AggressiveFloordataPackingTooltip:
Scan and mege similar floordata sequences.
Recommended mode for TR1-TR3 targets.
LevelSettings.Room32BitLightingTooltip:
Changes room lighting format from 16-bit to 32-bit, which fixes rainbow bug.
Requires specific FLEP patch to be activated, otherwise lighting will not look correct.
LevelSettings.Dither16BitTexturesTooltip: Apply dithering and premultiply alpha channel to brightness for 16-bit textures.
LevelSettings.CompressTexturesTooltip:
Use DirectX texture compression for all level textures.
 Use with caution, as it may cause artifacts on legacy small texture fragments.
LevelSettings.RemapAnimatedTextures: Map animated textures to imported geometry,objects and static meshes
LevelSettings.RemapAnimatedTexturesTooltip: Scan all objects for textures which are similar to any animated frame and apply animations to them.
LevelSettings.RearrangeVerticalRooms: Rearrange vertically connected rooms if necessary
LevelSettings.RearrangeVerticalRoomsTooltip:
Prioritize vertically connected rooms during compilation.
Allows to safely make more rooms until overall amount of vertically connected ones won't hit absolute limit.
LevelSettings.RemoveUnusedObjects: Remove unused objects from compiled level
LevelSettings.RemoveUnusedObjectsTooltip:
Removes moveables and statics that are in the WADs, but not placed in the level.
Use with caution in the case of dynamic object creation with scripts!
LevelSettings.CustomSampleRate: Use custom sample rate for sounds:
LevelSettings.CustomSampleRateTooltip:
Override original game sample rate with custom one.
May be necessary if level builder uses samples with custom sample rate.
LevelSettings.AutoAssignSounds: Autodetect sounds on compilation if none selected
